Badges must be worn at all times in the conference centre.
Session rooms are on the first floor; the Main Hall is on the ground floor.
Slides from all sessions will be shared with registered delegates after the event.

All rooms have step-free access and hearing loops. A quiet room is available on the first floor throughout the day. Large print copies of this programme are available on request. Please speak to the registration desk if you need any other support.
